postconditions.statement: fresh implementer proof is complete and discriminating

constraints: Allowed production files: scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py and scripts/hooks/gauge_writer_hook.py.
Allowed test files: tests/test_spine_rail.py and tests/test_gauge_writer.py.
Never reap a readable active lease by age; no lifecycle, journal, child, actor/PID, durable-root, or historical-backfill changes.
All writers lock one stable sibling lock file that is never replaced, from before load through reap, mutation, temp close/flush, replacement, and cleanup.

POSIX uses flock on the stable handle. Windows initializes one byte, seeks to zero, locks/unlocks that byte with msvcrt, closes temp handles before replace, and fails open on contention, timeout, lock API, or filesystem errors.
If the production spawn topology cannot show an unlocked lost update, return an honest scoped null; do not manufacture proof.
